title_suffix: four helper-donor cold kernels (pivots 531, 543, 555, 567) composed with multi-donor idle exchanges toward rank 51
summary: Composes rohanarun's #1297 four helper-donor cold kernels (pivots 531/543/555/567; 531 from Jeremy Kothe's #1274) with the multi-donor idle rank-48 exchange overlay (#1252 method, generalised to donor stars in #1268/#1280): 3,251 donors and 5,025 receivers turn idle H48=11374 into H42=1774, H45=1477, H48=3098, H51=5025 with axis unions, owners and dispatch unchanged. Both new local words get fresh native replays; the overlay adds an independent structural verifier and an exact emitted-stream operator check (T and the Z4 phase form of every changed port, chronology and shifts included, plus direct evaluation on random basis states) before the overlay-aware controller audit, invoice and strict assembly with 114 admission and 12 bit controls.
credits: Four helper-donor cold kernel words and profile: #1297 (rohanarun) building on #1286, #1274 (Jeremy Kothe, pivot 531 mechanism) and #1218 (rohanarun) / #1193 (jeremydiviney) / #1148 (tomdif) / #1195 / #987,#1225 construction. Idle exchange method and overlay-aware audit: #1252 (Gonzalo-Mier); donor-star ceiling analysis #1276 (PatatePatatePatate); packing-cap analysis #1240/#1264 (Mister-Meeseeks). Overlay as in #1268/#1280. Research direction, prioritisation and release strategy: jeremykothe2. Implementation assistance: oh-my-pi.
